data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's mechanism conflates identical observable error signatures with a shared causal trigger, but this is not a reliable evidentiary discriminator. The 'Telemetry Gap' countercondition only covers missing logs; the deeper fault is that the same error signature can arise from fully independent causes (two independent bugs producing the same parse failure in different deployments of the same library), while a shared cause can produce diverse signatures (a common upstream outage causing one node to timeout, another to OOM). Thus 'Error Signature Diversity' is neither necessary nor sufficient for independence, so it does not distinguish truly independent from merely apparently uncorrelated failures as the problem demands.
